releaseNotes: Arabic is here — switch the whole app to Arabic with full right-to-left layout (Settings, Appearance, Language), or keep English. Make it yours: six theme colors (Nokiatis Green, Ocean, Violet, Sunset, Rose, Gold), three corner styles (Sharp, Soft, Round) and an optional 3D depth lift. Share anything the Nokiatis way: songs, albums and your own playlists now share a Nokiatis MUC link that opens directly inside the app on your friend's phone — a shared playlist arrives ready to play. Plus the usual polish under the hood.
